Maryland is on pace for its lowest homicide rate in more than 40 years, non-fatal shootings are down by over 50%, juvenile homicides are down nearly 40%, and in Baltimore, homicide rates are at the lowest rate since the state began keeping records in 1975.

Tonight we celebrate the progress we’ve made and look forward to making even more progress as our work continues.
